English: Wooden Ark
A humble, frontier sanctuary built of rough-hewn timber, sheltering the sacred Ark and a few scrolls.
Stone Ark
A sturdier sanctuary of chiseled stone, protecting the Ark from weather and raiders, and housing a small congregation.
Enclosed Ark Sanctuary
A modest, walled sanctuary with a dedicated space for study and prayer, and improved security for the Ark.
Decorated Ark Sanctuary
A sanctuary adorned with intricate decorations, inspiring awe and reverence, and attracting renowned scholars.
Ornate Ark Sanctuary
A lavish sanctuary featuring ornate carvings, fine tapestries, and a grand Ark, drawing pilgrims and scholars from afar.
Ark Sanctuary Hall
A grand hall added to the sanctuary, hosting ritual gatherings, feasts, and advanced religious instruction for the faithful.
Sanctified Ark Sanctuary
A sanctuary sanctified by esteemed rabbis, its presence enhances the faith and learning of the community.
Blessed Ark Sanctuary
A sanctuary renowned for miracles and blessings, its Ark said to inspire great piety and wisdom throughout the land.
Grand Ark Sanctuary
A monumental sanctuary, resplendent in beauty and scholarship, a beacon of faith and wisdom for the entire realm.
Great Synagogue Ark Sanctuary
The preeminent sanctuary, a legendary seat of learning and faith whose Ark draws pilgrims, sages, and rulers from distant lands.
